, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscompared the directors’ birth dates by focusing on month/day within a year (June 20 vs. November 3) while ignoring the years, incorrectly concluding that 1965 (Boaz Yakin) is earlier than 1938 (Pupi Avati). This led to the wrong final answer; Pupi Avati (1938) was born first, so the correct film is La Mazurka Del Barone, Della Santa E Del Fico Fiorone.
